categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the orthopedic medical devices sector, focusing on implantable orthopedic medical devices including joint prostheses (hip, knee, shoulder, elbow, small joints), spinal implants, trauma products, sports medicine products, bone repair materials, surgical instruments, PRP preparation kits, oral care products, and orthopedic surgical robots. It also extends into oral medical consumables and surgical power devices through subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced low-friction joint interface technology, personalized bio-model femoral technology based on Chinese anatomical data, press-fit biological acetabulum technology, revision prosthesis filling technology using 3D printing, and proprietary manufacturing processes such as chemical vapor deposition (CVD) for porous tantalum implants. The company employs traditional subtractive manufacturing and additive manufacturing (3D printing) including EBM and MJF technologies, and has developed proprietary orthopedic surgical robots with autonomous sensing and control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are hospitals and medical institutions requiring orthopedic implantable devices and surgical instruments. The company serves patients needing joint replacement, spinal surgery, trauma repair, sports medicine treatment, and oral care. It also targets international markets through overseas sales and OEM/ODM partnerships.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Beijing and production facilities in Beijing, Hebei, and Jiangsu provinces. It has an overseas wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong and actively expands its international market presence, holding product registrations in multiple countries including CE certification and FDA approval for knee joint prostheses.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the orthopedic medical device supply chain, focusing on R&D, manufacturing, and sales of finished implantable devices and surgical instruments. It also has upstream involvement through its subsidiary engaged in alloy material production and processing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation-driven development with significant R&D investment in new materials (porous tantalum, magnesium alloys, PEEK), advanced manufacturing technologies (3D printing, CVD), and digital/robotic surgical systems. The company emphasizes expanding product lines, enhancing product competitiveness, and international market expansion, supported by government-funded projects and industry standards development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of orthopedic implantable devices, surgical instruments, and related consumables. Sales channels include distributor networks, direct sales to hospitals, third-party logistics providers, and overseas sales via OEM/ODM and distributor models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the orthopedic implant market in China, recognized as a national manufacturing champion in artificial joint prostheses. It competes with other domestic listed companies such as Aikang Medical, DaBo Medical, Weigao Orthopedics, Kellytech, and Sanyou Medical. It holds a strong market position with a comprehensive product portfolio and technological leadership in domestic substitution of imported products.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 806 million, a 33.3% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to national centralized procurement policies leading to price reductions. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 125 million, down 55%. Despite short-term declines, the company maintains a strong asset base of RMB 3.47 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D (16.5% of revenue). International sales grew by 78.3%, indicating growth potential.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, innovative orthopedic implant products tailored to Chinese anatomical characteristics, leveraging proprietary technologies such as low-friction joint interfaces, personalized implants, and advanced materials like porous tantalum and degradable magnesium alloys. Its surgical robots enhance surgical precision and outcomes. The company’s comprehensive product lines and strong quality control, combined with national certifications and international registrations, differentiate it as a reliable and technologically advanced supplier in the orthopedic medical device market.
